canonical_epg_binding_matched_fields_che.name: canonical_epg_binding_matched_fields_check
canonical_epg_binding_matched_fields_che.value: ("canonical_epg_bindings"."status" not in ('matched_manual', 'matched_auto')) or ("canonical_epg_bindings"."xmltv_source_id" is not null and "canonical_epg_bindings"."xmltv_channel_id" is not null)

oauth_clients_kind_secret_check.name: oauth_clients_kind_secret_check
oauth_clients_kind_secret_check.value:
("oauth_clients"."client_kind" = 'public_device' AND "oauth_clients"."secret_hash" IS NULL AND "oauth_clients"."secret_prefix" IS NULL)
        OR ("oauth_clients"."client_kind" = 'confidential' AND "oauth_clients"."secret_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "oauth_clients"."secret_prefix" IS NOT NULL)

device_clients_status_check.name: device_clients_status_check
device_clients_status_check.value:
("device_clients"."status" = 'active' AND "device_clients"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "device_clients"."revoked_by" IS NULL)
        OR ("device_clients"."status" = 'revoked' AND "device_clients"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "device_clients"."revoked_by" IS NOT NULL)
